lessons: STALE fix: per-child (<18) contents-compensation supplement was ~5,200 furniture / ~750 clothing / ~9,000 total; official Jan-2026 gazetted figures are 4,964 / 710 / 8,460. Fixed in references/compensation-ceilings.md, SKILL_HE.md, and evidence.json.

Coverage/freshness: added Operation Am K'Lavi (Rising Lion), the 12-day Iran war of June 2025 that caused widespread ballistic-missile home damage and prompted the Tax Authority fast track, to the covered-conflicts framing in the body (alongside Iron Swords and Shaagat HaAri). The direct-damage process is identical across wars; added to the body Problem section rather than the frontmatter description to avoid a description-eval cycle for a purely additive war name.

OVERTURNED, DO NOT TRUST THIS ENTRY'S ORIGINAL CLAIM. This cycle originally recorded 'VERIFIED OK (no change)' for: max premium 3,111, and contents ceilings single ~52,750 / family-of-4 ~102,725. The 2026-08-09 pass (v1.4.1) found all three unsupported. 3,111 appears in NO publication; it is 0.3% x 1,037,100 computed by hand and presented as a published figure, now deleted. The ~52,750 / ~102,725 ceiling table was the wrong table and had already been replaced in the English body, but was still live in references/compensation-ceilings.md, which read_skill_reference serves straight to an agent mid-conversation. What DID hold on re-check: fast track <=30,000, contents insurance 0.3%, max insurable 1,037,100, and the 14-day / 3-month deadlines, each now backed by a live verbatim Kol Zchut quote. LESSON: a 'VERIFIED OK (no change)' line is worthless unless it names the source it was verified against. Never record a bare verification verdict again.

CRITICAL fix (expert+judge-found, pre-existing): the family-of-5 contents ceiling was ~150,000; it must be ~110,000 (couple 84,349 + 3 x 8,460 per-child = ~109,700). Fixed in SKILL_HE, references, evidence.

CRITICAL fix (expert-found, pre-existing): vehicle war/missile damage was routed to 'private car insurance', but comprehensive motor policies EXCLUDE war, exactly like home insurance. War damage to a vehicle is paid by the Mas Rechush Compensation Fund (regular track; a Fund appraiser must approve the repair before it is done at any garage; 14-day notice + 3-month claim). Verified via gov.il / kolzchut / CPA sources. Fixed the Step-1 routing table (EN+HE) and narrowed the do-NOT description from 'car damage' to 'ordinary road-accident car damage', so war-vehicle queries route here. Removed the blanket car-insurance routing.

CARRY (MAJOR, deferred): add municipal hotline 106 reporting and a generalized 'get appraiser approval before any repair' step (now relevant to vehicles too); relabel the ~10,000 supplement as 'per additional adult' (not 'elderly relative'); soften the 14-day-forfeiture framing (both 14-day notice and 3-month claim are extendable on justified request).

WATCH (tooling): a blanket numeric replace on evidence.json corrupted 52,750 -> 52,710 because '750 ש'/'750 NIS' is a substring of '52,750 ש'; always anchor numeric replacements (use the full token) when a smaller figure is a substring of a larger one.
Purged a false verification record: the v1.2.2 cycle logged 'VERIFIED OK (no change)' for 3,111 and the ~52,750/~102,725 ceilings, none of which were actually sourced. See the amended lesson above.

CRITICAL fix: 20 of 35 evidence entries were literal 'raw_snippet: PENDING_VERIFICATION' with 'source_url: TBD', covering the entire numeric ruleset a claimant acts on. The old gate passed them because self-consistency only checks that a number in the body also appears in evidence.json, and the placeholder sat where a quote belongs. 7 sourced with live verbatim quotes, 13 deleted as orphans, 1 (3,111) deleted as unsourceable.

CRITICAL fix: references/compensation-ceilings.md still served the superseded ceiling table under a header admitting the figures were 'approximate', after the body had already been corrected. Fixing a body without fixing references/ leaves the wrong numbers fully live, because read_skill_reference serves that file directly to the agent.
Fixed EN/HE drift: SKILL_HE.md still asserted 1,037,100 and 3,111 after the English had removed them.
Four nevo regulation-8/9/10 snippets were re-worded summaries presented as verbatim quotes. A paraphrase is well-formed, so no lint catches it; only fetching the statute does.

CARRY: gov.il israel_tax_authority and online-direct-damage-claim Cloudflare-403 every fetcher; both read live in a browser with location.href asserted and recorded verified_via: browser. Re-confirm by eye next cycle.

CARRY resolved: 'appraiser approval before any repair' generalised (Tax Authority guide: no clearing or repair before the appraiser, cracked glass excepted); 'per additional adult' relabel and the softened forfeiture framing were already in place. Municipal 106: no Tax Authority or Kol Zchut source names it as a reporting channel, so it was NOT added (the sources name only the local authority's hotline, for alternative housing).

STALE fix: the gov.il guide published a 01.07.2026 contents column on 01.07.2026 and nobody re-checked. Every furniture and electrical cell went DOWN. Keep both columns and pick by damage date; re-check gov.il every January and July. The gov.il content API (the verifier's fetch) reads gov.il when curl and browsers are Cloudflare-blocked.

CRITICAL fixes the previous cycles' gates missed: the appeal committee is 3 members (reg 12), not 2; the District Court route is an appeal as of right on law only (reg 12א), not leave; 'vaadat-erar@taxes.gov.il' in references was fabricated (Ararim@ is real, confirmed by gov.il and a decoded kolzchut cfemail token). LESSON: references/ files were never read by the judge in earlier cycles; brief the judge to read them.

Kol Zchut obfuscates email addresses as Cloudflare cfemail ('[email protected]'); a snippet containing the address can never match. Decode the data-cfemail token from the raw HTML to verify, and quote the surrounding text.

Legal gate BLOCKed the first draft of the appeal artifact (a filing-ready ערר is a §20(3) document). It is now a checklist plus candidate grounds as points; never re-introduce 'write the appeal' in body, examples, enriched prompts or value-add case wording.

Arithmetic reviewer found the 4th Step-5 defect: 'single parent uses the couple column' without regulation 1's under-18 condition overstated a parent of adult children by ~32,500. Round 2 then caught a repair defect: a written-off car is the drop in value (minus salvage), not the full pre-damage value.
